analysis.title: Energy Fuels Inc. (UUUU): Uranium results mixed, while rare earths platform advances despite extended timelines
key_insights: UUUU reported mixed 3Q26 results. Revenue of ~$29mn missed GSe/FactSet consensus of $39mn/$33mn, driven by 320,000 lbs of U3O8 sold versus GS's 450,000 lb estimate.

Average realized uranium price was ~$89/lb versus GS's $84/lb estimate, in line with spot prices, because lower-priced contracts were mostly filled in 1H26. Spot sales of 50,000 lbs averaged $89.50 and long-term contract sales of 270,000 lbs averaged $88.79.
Mined production of 385,000 lbs of U3O8 was below GS's 700,000 lb estimate. 3Q26 EBITDA of ($23mn) missed GSe/consensus of ($4mn)/($7mn) on higher opex, including transaction-related costs.

2026 guidance was mostly reiterated, but uranium sales are now tracking toward the low end of the 1.5mn-2.0mn lb range. Mining volumes could finish below the 2.0mn-2.5mn lb range after lower-than-expected grades at Pinyon Plain, with 1.1mn lbs mined YTD.
Management added a second mining shift and expects higher grades in the current mining zones and then the Juniper Zone, supporting a sequential increase in 4Q26 production.
UUUU has processed 1.7mn lbs of uranium YTD, within its 1.5mn-2.5mn lb guidance. The next mill campaign is expected to begin around December and run through 1Q27.
UUUU ended 3Q26 with 2.4mn lbs of finished and contained uranium, including 1.3mn lbs of finished goods, versus 2.3mn lbs and 1.6mn lbs in 2Q26.

The rare earths mine-to-magnet strategy is advancing, but several timelines have shifted right by about one year versus expectations earlier in 2026. ASM closed in August and VAC remains targeted to close in early 2027.
Korean Metals Plant NdFeB alloy capacity is being expanded from ~1,300 tonnes/year to ~3,600 tonnes/year by early 2027.

White Mesa Phase 1B/1C is now expected in early 2028, versus prior expectations of commercial heavy rare earth oxide production in late 2027. The expansion also adds MREC capability to allow uranium and rare earths processing at the same time.

GS expects a monazite campaign at White Mesa in 2Q27 after the uranium campaign, processing existing Chemours inventory and potentially incremental monazite feedstock. Additional feedstock agreements are possible near term.

Donald remains on track for FID by year-end with first production in late 2028. Vara Mada depends on government approvals, Dubbo could move up the development queue, and Bahia is now positioned behind Donald, Vara Mada and potentially Dubbo.
GS cut 2026E revenue to $126.3mn from $146.1mn and lowered 2026E EBITDA to ($79mn) from ($52mn). 2027E EBITDA moves to ($4mn) from ($6mn) and 2028E is unchanged at $25mn.

GS is Not Rated on UUUU. Goldman Sachs is acting as financial advisor on an announced strategic matter involving Energy Fuels, so the rating, price target and estimates are restricted under its policy.

market_movers.rationale: GS is Not Rated on UUUU, with no price target, because it is advising on a strategic transaction involving the company. The note covers 3Q26 results and estimate changes only.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (Sep-26 quarter) reported revenue $29.2mn versus GS estimate $33.3mn in the company-results exhibit. The text cites GSe/FactSet consensus of $39mn/$33mn. Revenue was up 65% y/y and up 16% q/q.
3Q26 reported adj. EBITDA ($23.1mn) versus GS estimate ($7.7mn), and the text cites GSe/consensus of ($4mn)/($7mn). EPS was reported at ($0.20) versus GS estimate ($0.04).
3Q26 operating expenses were $54.5mn versus GS estimate $42.5mn. Transactions and integration costs were $9.0mn against none estimated. Other expense, net was ($27.5mn) against none estimated.
3Q26 free cash flow to equity was ($35.3mn) versus GS estimate ($23.9mn). Operating cash flow was ($20.7mn) and capex was ($14.6mn).

GS 2026E EPS moves to ($0.41) from ($0.22). 2027E EPS moves to $0.00 from ($0.04) and 2028E moves to $0.03 from ($0.02). 2026E revenue is $126.3mn versus prior $146.1mn, 2027E is $200.3mn versus $207.5mn and 2028E is $281.7mn versus $280.8mn.
GS quarterly EPS estimates are ($0.02) for 12/26E, ($0.01) for 3/27E and $0.01 for 6/27E.
risk_factors: Uranium mining grades at Pinyon Plain came in lower than expected, putting 2026 mined volumes at risk of finishing below the 2.0mn-2.5mn lb guidance range.
Uranium sales are tracking toward the low end of the 1.5mn-2.0mn lb guidance range.
Rare earths development timelines have shifted about one year to the right, including White Mesa Phase 1B/1C and first production at Donald.
Vara Mada remains subject to government approvals, and the VAC acquisition is not yet closed.
Opex, including transaction and integration costs, ran above estimates.
